turns.text: Morning Diego. I pulled up our running 1:1 Google Doc. Let's start with the Atlas auth token dual-write cutover before we look at the Redis spike.
Sounds good. Initially I thought we could kill legacy v1 tokens tomorrow, maybe Thursday afternoon, once the mobile clients finish updating.
Actually, scratch Thursday. Two enterprise webhooks are still sending v1 headers. Let's decide to keep dual-write token validation active through Friday at 5pm so we don't drop partner traffic.
Agreed. Decision made: we keep dual-write token validation active through Friday 5pm. I'll update Reza's roadmap doc with the Friday cutover date right after this.
On the Redis queue side, key fact from last night's load test: the staging Redis cluster CPU peaks at 78% during batch sync because connection pooling resets every 60 seconds.
I'll put together the zero-downtime token cutover script and the Redis pool patch before Thursday noon so Sam can review it.
One unscheduled topic before we wrap: for our open engineering headcount, let me send you the revised system design rubric by end of day today so we're calibrated for Monday's loop.
